title: Setup window finishes with no caregiver, leaving every escalation with nowhere to go
method: drove gui.run() through a recording stub for the widget layer only; all validation, state and config logic executed is gui.py's own
triggers: leave both caregiver questions blank and press Next
observed_at_discovery: questions() marks only name and phone required; caregiver_name and caregiver_phone carry no required flag, while wizard.py asks both with optional=False. Driving gui.run() with those two blank wrote ~/.cura/robert.json containing "emergency_contacts": [] and "primary_caregiver": {} while the closing screen reads "Cura is ready." Feeding that config to CuraVoice: alert_caregiver() dialled to_number='' and returned answered=False with the error swallowed; crisis_alert() returned []. pytest exit 1, 1 failed. NOTE: cura/setup/gui.py is untracked at 57cb15c, so this repro cannot run until it is committed.
